Wonderful food and great value!
Jan 2026 • Business
Wonderful food and great value!

I had a very enjoyable dining experience at La Libra Steak House. The food was genuinely delicious the steak was cooked perfectly, the grilled ribs were juicy and full of flavor and the duck breast was especially impressive. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into each dish.

The restaurant offers an elegant and comfortable atmosphere, suitable for both intimate dinners and special occasions. Considering the quality of the food and the setting, the prices are very reasonable.

One small personal concern I noticed is that many tables around us seemed to leave their dishes sitting for quite a long time just to take photos. When food is left too long, it can cool down and lose its juiciness, making it harder to fully appreciate the flavors and the chef’s dedication. This is simply my personal observation, as the food itself is truly good and deserves to be enjoyed at its best.

Overall, a lovely dining experience and a place I would happily recommend.
